title: AlgoEvolve：基于LLM的算法交易程序元进化框架
summary: 提出AlgoEvolve框架，利用大语言模型作为语义变异算子，通过进化算法生成、评估和迭代改进算法交易策略。引入元进化外层循环自动优化提示，在噪声、非平稳的金融环境中实现自适应策略逻辑，显著优于人工设计指令。
summary_en: AlgoEvolve uses LLMs as semantic mutation operators in an evolutionary framework to generate and improve algorithmic trading strategies. A meta-evolutionary outer loop optimizes prompts, achieving adaptive strategy logic in noisy, non-stationary financial environments, outperforming human-designed instructions.
